title: Disk Space Mystery
description: One application directory is consuming much more disk space than the others.
mission: Identify the largest top-level directory and write its name into answer.txt.
success: You identified cache as the largest directory.

lesson.what_happened: Directory-level disk usage showed cache was much larger than its peers.
lesson.be_careful: df reports filesystem capacity; du reports file and directory usage.

hints: Compare directory sizes from the workspace root.
du summarizes disk usage; -h makes sizes easier to read.
